notes: Stock signals published through the cutoff; completed target-date exits only.
Next eligible exchange open after the later publication/recommendation timestamp; saved target-date close, or next session if closed.
Prices are split/dividend-adjusted model prices, not broker fills.
All monthly returns are full holding-period returns grouped by exit month, not portfolio returns.
SPY uses identical entry and exit dates; European signals have no US benchmark.
CSV percent columns use percentage points: 12.5 means 12.5%.
Net scenarios subtract 0.10 or 0.20 percentage points of entry notional as assumed round-trip friction.
Currently saved target dates are used; historical revisions are not reconstructed.
Pending/Hold signal details are excluded from public downloads.

allocation.defaultBasis: User-specified 1% fallback when the suggested allocation was not saved
allocation.note: Retrospective reconstruction from currently saved risk ratings, not a verified archive of original publication weights.

assumptions: Retrospective model: each month’s full $1,000 is split across eligible entries using normalized suggested weights; the final signal set is not known in advance.
Saved risk mapping 7%, 5%, 3%, 2%, 1%; missing risk uses 1%.
Both accounts receive $1,000 on the first US trading session each month. SPY buys at that open; signals use their next eligible open.
US listings only; four European listings excluded. Fractional shares, no additional leverage.
All signal sale proceeds are locked as non-interest-bearing cash and never reinvested. Unused contribution cash earns no interest.
Target-date close exits; pending/Hold positions marked to December 31, 2025.
One short signal reserves cash equal to notional; proceeds cannot fund purchases. Borrowing availability, fees and broker margin rules not modeled.
Adjusted prices; no fees, slippage, taxes or subscription costs. Current saved target dates and ratings are used.
Monthly returns and drawdown remove the effect of contributions. Gain on contributions is profit divided by total deposits, not an annualized rate.
